column1: # Gene sets for aggregate TSS coverage profiles (cfdna_frag.py tss).
# Active promoters are nucleosome-depleted, so cfDNA from cells that express a gene shows a
# coverage dip at its TSS. At low coverage only set-level aggregates are interpretable.
# Columns: set <tab> gene symbol. Edit / extend freely; the set names become plot panels.
# lung_epithelium: alveolar type 1/2 and airway epithelium (donor lung in a transplant)
# neutrophil, lymphocyte, megakaryocyte_erythroid: the main contributors to plasma cfDNA
# housekeeping: positive control (dip expected in every sample)
# inactive_control: genes silent in blood and lung (no dip expected; captures GC/mappability bias)
